candidates.original_title: Proposal for a Novel Classification of Patients With Enlarged Ventricles and Cognitive Impairment Based on Data-Driven Analysis of Neuroimaging Results in Patients With Psychiatric Disorders
candidates.description: Data-driven classification identifies a novel subtype of psychiatric disorders characterized by pronounced enlarged ventricles and cognitive impairment (EVCI), predominantly associated with schizophrenia.
candidates.citation_sentence: These findings are consistent with the trends observed in our previous study (see Table S1, which is a modified version of table 5 in the previous paper [6]).
